name: Ruth
summary: A woman of Moab who would not leave her mother-in-law Naomi and came to trust the God of Israel. She married Boaz of Bethlehem and became the great-grandmother of David.

key_moments.title: Staying with Naomi
key_moments.description: When Naomi told her to go back to her own people, Ruth held on to her. She promised to go where Naomi went, to make Naomi's people her people and Naomi's God her God.

key_moments.title: Gleaning in Boaz's Field
key_moments.description: Ruth gathered leftover grain in the field of Boaz, a relative of Naomi's husband. Boaz had heard of her kindness to Naomi, so he gave her food and told his young men to leave extra grain for her.

key_moments.title: Goes to Boaz at the Threshing Floor
key_moments.description: Ruth lay at the feet of Boaz in the night and asked him to spread his garment over her, because he was a near kinsman. He blessed her and said everyone knew she was a virtuous woman.

key_moments.title: Marries Boaz
key_moments.description: Boaz bought the land of Naomi's family and took Ruth as his wife before the elders. The LORD gave her a son, Obed, the grandfather of David.
